answer: Random mutual audits stop Sybils: each epoch pairs a random auditor with an auditee, each identity one vertex in the audit graph. The auditor reproduces the work; unreproducible forged logs slash the auditee's deposit. An attacker fielding N fakes loses: mirror-audits exposing puppets rubber-stamping each other slash both sides. Keeping N fakes costs N × (real work or bribes) per epoch, linear in N, while one honest agent does its normal work.
